title: Dreams kicking me out
content: Usually in my mall world dreams, I spend my time playing video games wherever I am at. I enjoy playing lots of video games. I know that it may seem like a coping mechanism, but it's the only time I have fun aside from eating inside food places. Normally, when I least expect it, my dream turns into a nightmare and I am forced to fight with all of my might. The last dream I had which happened about 2 hours ago, there were 2 robbers that were twice my size were just stealing things from the house I was at. For some reason, they were just stealing poker chips, and they saw my heavy backpack. I told them that it was filled with video games. As they were approaching my backpack, I started to defend my belongings, but then they just went straight away to attacking me. As a last resort, I had no choice but to repeat a self made mantra, and somehow as I was doing that while I was attacking them, the dream decided to fade away slowly. That always happens when I resort to my mantra. Usually, I have used my mantra towards alien/ shadow beings who can shapeshift, but this time it was my first time towards astral humans.
